unit.can_do_en: Can order simple items, ask the price, and say thanks.

situation_en: Anna stands at the counter of a busy café in Helsinki. The barista, Emma, greets her. Anna politely asks for a coffee and a cinnamon bun. Emma asks whether she wants oat milk in the coffee, and Anna says yes. Emma hands them over and they both say thanks.

speakers.name: Anna
speakers.role_en: a customer ordering her morning coffee
